observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an outdoor paved courtyard with a tiled floor and a yellow and grey wall in the background
observation.dancers: six female youth dancers in a group
observation.formation_and_space: a single horizontal line facing forward, occasionally shifting positions or turning
observation.posture: upright posture with relaxed knees, weight shifting gently between feet
observation.footwork: small side-to-side stepping and weight shifts on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held at shoulder or waist height, holding and waving folding fans
observation.hips_and_torso: torso upright with minimal hip movement
observation.levels_jumps_turns: starts kneeling on the floor, rises to standing, occasional turns in place
observation.costume_and_props: matching red tops, long patterned skirts, black hijabs, face masks, and folding fans (red and orange)
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement is occluded by long skirts and low camera angle

signature_moments.what: dancers kneeling in a line holding fans open across their chests
arms sweeping wide outward while holding open fans
stepping and turning in place with fans held high
